name: English
tagline: Turn an idea into images and videos. Learn from prompts you can reuse.
intro: SeaImagine is an online AI image and video creation platform for creators, designers and small teams. Start with text or a reference image, explore a model, and refine your scene.
why: We share prompt libraries so creators can see how subject, camera movement, timing and sound fit together. Browse an illustrated example, copy its prompt, and adapt one element at a time.
project_descriptions: A multimodal video library with a category index, reference first frames and reusable prompts, featuring attributed official and community examples.
Video prompts, illustrated examples and downloadable text organized by topic, covering camera movement, characters, products and sound.
A video creation library with community video examples, source links and shot-by-shot prompts.
project_audiences: Storytelling, product shorts and video editing
Social videos, product showcases and character shots
Advertising, shot planning and reference-image-led shorts
image_note: These images are prompt library covers. Select one to explore its examples and sources.
tool_uses: Describe a scene and turn it into video.
Bring a still reference image into motion.
Create images for a story or product.
Modify and refine an existing image.
steps: Choose an example and copy its prompt.
Select a model on SeaImagine, then enter text or upload a reference image.
Check subject consistency, camera movement and sound. Change one condition at a time.
contribute: Open an issue in the relevant repository, improve a translation, or contribute an example with its prompt, settings and source. Check each repository’s license before using its content.
footer: Start with one shot, then share useful techniques with other creators.
prompt_languages: Prompt languages vary by library. Check the documentation for each project.
